name: Mask Wall Adjacent to Trim (Spray)
intent: Tape and paper the wall adjacent to all trim edges before any spray application. Prevents overspray contamination of finished walls. Only fires for spray methods — brush trim work doesn't atomize so wall masking isn't needed.
doctrine: 150 LF/hr is slower than baseboard wall masking from the wall finish spec (200 LF/hr) because trim wall masking requires precise tape placement against finished trim profile, not against bare drywall. Height modifier applies for tall walls where the painter is on a ladder masking high trim like crown.
